description: Label a pull request: kind, size, risk, and whether tests or docs look missing. State: PR title, body, changed file list and diff (or diffstat).

kind.instructions: What kind of change is this pull request mainly?

criteria.bug-fix: Fixes something that was broken or behaving wrongly
criteria.feature: Adds new behavior or a new capability
criteria.docs: Only changes documentation, comments or READMEs
criteria.refactor: Restructures code without changing what it does
criteria.maintenance: Dependencies, CI, build, config or tooling

size.instructions: How big is this change for a reviewer?
criteria: Tiny: a few lines, reviewable at a glance
Small: one area, a few minutes to review
Medium: several files or areas, needs a careful read
Large: many files or a new subsystem, needs a long review

risk.instructions: If this change has a bug, how bad would the impact be?
criteria: Low: docs, tests, or code that is easy to undo and affects little
Medium: changes app behavior that users or other code rely on
High: touches data, auth, payments, deletion, secrets, or deployment

missing_tests.instructions: Does this pull request change program behavior without adding or updating any tests?

docs_needed.instructions: Does this pull request change setup steps, commands or user-facing behavior that the README or docs should mention but do not?
